This school has students from all backgrounds. Students from low-income and well-to-do families are classmates from kindergarten until they graduate high school. While well-to-do students flourish, many of the low-income students get off track and start dealing drugs in school. Who sells drugs in the school?
A. The well-to-do students
B. Not known
C. The low-income students
